plain: One basic arithmetic step by a computer. The total number used in training is a rough measure of how big a model's training run was.
eli5: One tiny sum. Counting all the sums a computer did tells you how hard it worked.
technical: A single floating-point arithmetic operation; cumulative training compute is expressed as a count of FLOP (for example 10<sup>25</sup>), not to be confused with FLOP/s, a rate that measures hardware speed.
